evidence: Source edits and manual source review only; no builds, syntax checks, tests, project/game execution, JNI calls, GPU/API execution, process inspection or Bedrock operations

sourcePort.nativeProducer: world_hooks.geometry_input(scope,width,height,reverseZ) copies one exact retained observation through live_frame.geometry_input without requiring Observation.depth
sourcePort.sharedPacketBuilder: The legacy live_frame.build path delegates to the same JSON builder and separately requires/downsamples its real depth image; projection, actor/appearance/timing/receipt fields remain shared
sourcePort.inputOwnership: Private GeometryInput fields hold owned JSON, session/sequence/surface/camera facts and a guarded numeric producer FrameKey; no native object reference or borrowed image buffer
sourcePort.inputBound: At most 1 MiB JSON is transmitted; retained history scope/session/sequence and the unique producer FrameKey must remain current
sourcePort.javaParser: WorldFrame.parseGeometry shares the full existing actor/appearance/equipment/pose/camera/timing validator with parse, skipping only CPU terrain-image validation/allocation
sourcePort.rasterSeparation: Geometry-only frames have an internal transient flag; WorldState.frame, WorldFrame.render and depthSnapshot reject their use as a software-renderable world/depth source
sourcePort.clientContext: Serialized client-thread geometry emission temporarily supplies that owned world to appearance/replay helpers, then restores platform.world and input availability in finally; WORLD/presentation readiness and body plans are not published
sourcePort.reentrancy: Geometry staging rejects nested world/presentation mutation and body/attachment-plan APIs while its temporary context is active
sourcePort.nativeConsumer: ClientVm.geometry_input requires a mutable client borrow, checks scope freshness before and after Java work, bounds the array before copying, decodes ARCGEO01..10 including optional material/visibility/texture identity, layer eligibility, model/glint and simple-phase data, and matches session/sequence/surface/space and exact camera/projection bits
sourcePort.clockAndAppearance: The existing WorldFrame.emitAvatars and NativeGeometryPacket retain acknowledged body/cape/emote/wing choices and rational replay samples; this path does not tick client/physics controllers
sourcePort.activation: When native cosmetics are enabled, the DX12 present owner selects exact submitted surface metadata without terrain readback; after its ordinary client frame imports textures and updates controllers, it calls geometry_input and stages an owned asynchronous upload if the packet has explicit entity material inputs. No Java calls run on native draw workers and no extra suppression/readiness authority is granted
sourcePort.completedConsumer: native_geometry_stream retains one pending upload ticket and one completed upload, rejects expired producer identities and camera/surface mismatches, and exposes only exact scope/size/reverse-Z lookup to Geometry.from_stream with independently supplied phase preparation and pose inputs

limitations: Client-thread scheduling and completed upload handoff are wired in source; the actual game-facing feature-phase caller remains absent
Surface/depth convention come from exact submitted native depth metadata; Java-equivalent live material/lightmap/fog and complete feature preparation/group inputs remain missing
Java appearance emission remains mutable client logic; it must run on its serialized client owner and is not a native draw-worker callback
An owned geometry packet and successful camera matching are not target ownership, GPU execution, presentation or parity evidence
General skin/glint/HDR material variants, native rendering, cape/emote fidelity and deterministic replay/video comparison remain unfinished
